combo_label: At the Supermarket × Horses & Riding × The Tudors

entries.clue: U of iron nailed under the foot, or hung above a door for luck
Rocking three-beat pace, named for the amble of pilgrims to Becket's shrine
White hairs peppered through a dark base — strawberry, if the base is chestnut
Mud and straw smeared over woven sticks to fill in a timber wall
Tiny one-serving sleeve of ketchup or sugar, torn at the corner
Thomas, the blacksmith's son who rose to fix the king's marriages
Anne who lost her head after failing to give him a son
Space at the back of the store where spare cases wait to fill gaps
Scribbled before you leave home, then ticked off item by item
One hauled before a church court for believing what the age forbade
Worn-out old plodder, or to go on and on at someone
Booked window of time in which the grocery van should arrive
